document_title: Flickr-LDL and Twitter-LDL Emotion Archetypes for SLR-C

archetypes.name: Pet in Costume
archetypes.core_difference: Separates from excitement by focusing on absurd humor and passive playfulness rather than high-energy thrill.
archetypes.visual_elements: golden retriever, oversized sunglasses, party hat, living room rug, warm natural light
archetypes.text_query: A golden retriever sits on a living room rug wearing oversized sunglasses and a colorful party hat, panting with a goofy expression in warm, cheerful natural light.

archetypes.name: Witty Street Sign
archetypes.core_difference: Relies on visual irony and object-based humor rather than human facial expressions.
archetypes.visual_elements: weathered sign, altered graffiti, funny punchline, urban setting, midday sunlight
archetypes.text_query: A weathered urban street sign features cleverly altered graffiti that turns a standard warning into a funny punchline, captured straight-on in bright, cheerful midday sunlight.

archetypes.name: Candid Photobomb
archetypes.core_difference: Unexpected, spontaneous human disruption in a formal setting, highlighting unexpected humor.
archetypes.visual_elements: formal wedding guest, posing group, leaping figure in background, grinning face, bright daylight
archetypes.text_query: During a formal outdoor wedding reception, a grinning guest playfully leaps into the background of a posed group photo, creating a candid, brightly lit moment of surprise.

archetypes.name: Muddy Child
archetypes.core_difference: Joyful, mischievous messiness in nature, distinguishing from pure contentment via playful action.
archetypes.visual_elements: toddler, wet brown mud, huge mischievous grin, backyard puddle, soft overcast daylight
archetypes.text_query: A toddler covered head-to-toe in wet brown mud flashes a huge, mischievous grin while sitting in a lush green backyard puddle under soft overcast daylight.

archetypes.name: Friends Laughing
archetypes.core_difference: Subtle, shared social amusement in a moody indoor setting, avoiding the extreme intensity of excitement.
archetypes.visual_elements: three friends, cafe table, heads tilted back laughing, coffee cups, warm amber lighting
archetypes.text_query: Three friends sit at a softly lit cafe table, heads tilted back in genuine, relaxed laughter over shared coffee cups, surrounded by warm amber indoor lighting.

archetypes.name: Street Performer
archetypes.core_difference: Intentional performative comedy utilizing exaggerated props and theatrical makeup in a public space.
archetypes.visual_elements: street clown, exaggerated face paint, juggling colorful pins, smiling onlookers, cobblestone walkway
archetypes.text_query: A brightly dressed street performer with exaggerated face paint juggles colorful bowling pins for a smiling crowd of onlookers on a bustling cobblestone pedestrian walkway.

emotions.definition: Strong displeasure, irritation, rage, or hostility.

archetypes.name: Fierce Protester
archetypes.core_difference: Distinguishes from disgust by showing active, assertive human hostility and shouting rather than physical aversion.
archetypes.visual_elements: screaming protester, clenched fist, dense urban crowd, furrowed brow, harsh contrasting light
archetypes.text_query: A passionate, furious protester stands in a dense urban crowd, screaming loudly with a tightly clenched fist and deeply furrowed brow under harsh, contrasting afternoon daylight.

archetypes.name: Traffic Road Rage
archetypes.core_difference: Everyday contextual frustration showing aggressive body language from inside a confined vehicle.
archetypes.visual_elements: driver leaning out window, stationary car, highway traffic jam, aggressive gesturing, glaring sun
archetypes.text_query: A driver leans out the window of a stationary car in a massive highway traffic jam, gesturing aggressively with a red, tense face amid glaring afternoon sun.

archetypes.name: Smashed Object
archetypes.core_difference: Evokes anger through the violent destruction of property without requiring human facial expressions.
archetypes.visual_elements: shattered computer monitor, chaotic messy desk, cracked dark glass, cold fluorescent overhead light
archetypes.text_query: A completely shattered computer monitor sits on a chaotic, paper-strewn desk, illuminated by cold fluorescent overhead light that emphasizes the violent cracks in the dark glass.

archetypes.name: Sports Confrontation
archetypes.core_difference: Interpersonal aggressive posturing and physical tension during a high-adrenaline outdoor event.
archetypes.visual_elements: two rival athletes, pressing foreheads together, glaring eyes, muddy grass field, tight framing
archetypes.text_query: Two rival athletes press their foreheads together on a muddy grass field, glaring fiercely into each other's eyes during a tense, tightly framed sports confrontation.

archetypes.name: Harsh Industrial Landscape
archetypes.core_difference: Environmental hostility using sharp angles, fire, and aggressive color palettes instead of living subjects.
archetypes.visual_elements: jagged metal ruins, towering smokestacks, deep shadows, intense fiery red sky, apocalyptic sunset
archetypes.text_query: Jagged metal ruins and towering smokestacks dominate a brutal industrial landscape, cast in intense, fiery red and deep shadow by a harsh, apocalyptic sunset.

archetypes.name: Snarling Animal
archetypes.core_difference: Primal, instinctual aggression in a gritty urban environment, separating from awe by signaling direct threat.
archetypes.visual_elements: large stray dog, bared sharp teeth, flattened ears, deep snarl, narrow concrete alley, low-angle light
archetypes.text_query: A large stray dog stands defensively in a narrow concrete alley, baring its sharp teeth with flattened ears and a deep snarl in gritty, low-angle urban lighting.

emotions.definition: Wonder or reverence caused by something impressive, sublime, or vast.

archetypes.name: Milky Way Galaxy
archetypes.core_difference: Differentiates from fear by portraying cosmic vastness as a majestic, peaceful spectacle rather than a terrifying unknown.
archetypes.visual_elements: tiny silhouetted figure, rocky outcrop, glowing Milky Way galaxy, vast clear night sky
archetypes.text_query: A tiny silhouetted figure stands on a rocky outcrop, looking up at the glowing, infinitely vast expanse of the Milky Way galaxy spanning the clear night sky.

archetypes.name: Cathedral Sun Rays
archetypes.core_difference: Architectural grandeur and sublime indoor lighting emphasizing reverence rather than everyday contentment.
archetypes.visual_elements: golden sun rays, intricate stained-glass windows, floating dust, stone floor, cavernous ancient cathedral
archetypes.text_query: Thick golden rays of sunlight stream through the intricate stained-glass windows of a colossal ancient cathedral, illuminating floating dust and casting vibrant, reverent colors across the stone floor.

archetypes.name: Macro Snowflake
archetypes.core_difference: Microscopic wonder revealing intricate hidden geometry, distinct from sweeping macro landscapes.
archetypes.visual_elements: symmetrical ice crystals, single snowflake, dark woolen glove, high-magnification macro, crisp cool light
archetypes.text_query: A high-magnification macro shot reveals the perfectly symmetrical, delicate ice crystals of a single snowflake resting on a dark woolen glove under crisp, cool winter lighting.

archetypes.name: Breaching Whale
archetypes.core_difference: Majestic wildlife displaying immense scale and power gracefully in a colorful outdoor setting.
archetypes.visual_elements: massive humpback whale, breaching glassy ocean surface, glittering water droplets, pastel pink sunset
archetypes.text_query: A massive humpback whale breaches the glassy ocean surface, sending glittering water droplets into the air against a breathtaking backdrop of a pastel pink sunset.

archetypes.name: Mountain Summit
archetypes.core_difference: Geological majesty emphasizing extreme elevation and an expansive horizon viewed by a lone subject.
archetypes.visual_elements: lone mountaineer, dramatic snow-capped summit, sea of jagged peaks, fluffy low clouds, brilliant morning sunlight
archetypes.text_query: A lone mountaineer gazes out from a dramatic, snow-capped summit over an endless sea of jagged peaks and low-hanging fluffy clouds in brilliant, clear morning sunlight.

archetypes.name: Rocket Launch
archetypes.core_difference: Technological sublime blending intense blinding energy with monumental human achievement.
archetypes.visual_elements: towering spacecraft, lifting off launchpad, blinding pillar of golden fire, dark dusk sky, billowing smoke
archetypes.text_query: A towering spacecraft lifts off the launchpad on a blinding pillar of golden fire, illuminating the dark dusk sky and surrounding smoke with intense, awe-inspiring radiance.

emotions.definition: Calm satisfaction, comfort, serenity, or peaceful happiness.

archetypes.name: Sleeping Cat
archetypes.core_difference: Contrasts with amusement by focusing on peaceful rest, passive warmth, and closed eyes rather than active play.
archetypes.visual_elements: orange tabby cat, curled up, warm glowing sunbeam, plush armchair, eyes closed
archetypes.text_query: An orange tabby cat curls up peacefully in a warm, glowing square of sunlight on a plush living room armchair, eyes fully closed in deep rest.

archetypes.name: Tea in the Rain
archetypes.core_difference: Quiet contemplation mixing indoor safety with gentle outdoor weather, separating from sadness through cozy warmth.
archetypes.visual_elements: person in knit blanket, sitting by large window, steaming mug of tea, soft falling rain
archetypes.text_query: A calm person wrapped in a thick knit blanket sits comfortably by a large window, holding a steaming mug of tea while watching soft, gentle rain fall outdoors.

archetypes.name: Glassy Alpine Lake
archetypes.core_difference: Separates from sadness by utilizing warm pastel colors, perfect symmetry, and undisturbed pristine nature to evoke peace.
archetypes.visual_elements: mirror-like alpine lake, soft lavender and peach dawn, misty pine trees, perfect stillness, no people
archetypes.text_query: A perfectly still, mirror-like alpine lake reflects the soft lavender and peach hues of a quiet dawn, framed by gentle, misty pine trees in complete solitude.

archetypes.name: Elderly Couple Strolling
archetypes.core_difference: Enduring, quiet human connection over time rather than the volatile high energy of excitement.
archetypes.visual_elements: elderly couple, holding hands, relaxed pace, leaf-covered park path, warm golden autumn light
archetypes.text_query: An elderly couple holds hands affectionately as they stroll at a relaxed pace down a tranquil, leaf-covered park path bathed in the warm, golden light of autumn.

archetypes.name: Cozy Workspace
archetypes.core_difference: Object-based satisfaction derived from order, cleanliness, and warm lighting in a solitary indoor environment.
archetypes.visual_elements: neatly organized wooden desk, open journal, glowing desk lamp, small potted succulent, dim evening room
archetypes.text_query: A neatly organized, minimalist wooden desk holds an open journal, a glowing desk lamp, and a small potted succulent in a calming, dimly lit evening room.

archetypes.name: Dog by Campfire
archetypes.core_difference: Intimate, secure bonding in a gentle outdoor setting, balancing dark shadows with warm firelight.
archetypes.visual_elements: tired dog, resting head on owner's knee, gently crackling campfire, dark shadows, peaceful forest
archetypes.text_query: A tired dog rests its heavy head comfortably on its owner's knee beside a gently crackling campfire, surrounded by the soft, dark shadows of a peaceful forest.

emotions.definition: Revulsion, aversion, contamination response, or strong dislike.

archetypes.name: Rotting Fruit
archetypes.core_difference: Distinguishes from anger by evoking biological aversion via decay and contamination rather than physical hostility.
archetypes.visual_elements: bruised rotting peaches, fuzzy blue mold, swarming fruit flies, stained kitchen counter, ceramic bowl
archetypes.text_query: A ceramic bowl of severely bruised, rotting peaches is covered in fuzzy blue mold and swarming with tiny fruit flies on a neglected, deeply stained kitchen counter.

archetypes.name: Overflowing Trash
archetypes.core_difference: Urban grime and poor sanitation triggering environmental revulsion, utilizing a direct human aversion gesture.
archetypes.visual_elements: pedestrian pinching nose, overflowing leaking garbage bags, damp dim city alleyway
archetypes.text_query: A pedestrian pinches their nose while quickly walking past a massive pile of leaking, split garbage bags in a damp, dimly lit city alleyway.

archetypes.name: Slimy Parasite
archetypes.core_difference: Visceral response to unpleasant, moist textures and creepy-crawly subjects via tight macro photography.
archetypes.visual_elements: gelatinous slug, decaying wet leaves, slimy textured skin, tight macro shot, harsh cold flash
archetypes.text_query: A tight macro shot captures a thick, gelatinous slug crawling over decaying wet leaves, its slimy textured skin gleaming under harsh, cold camera flash.

archetypes.name: Toxic Sludge
archetypes.core_difference: Ecological contamination emphasizing unnatural, sickly colors in a landscape rather than biological rot.
archetypes.visual_elements: neon-green chemical sludge, rusty industrial pipe, stagnant murky river, dead vegetation, bleak grey sky
archetypes.text_query: Thick, unnatural neon-green chemical sludge pours from a rusty industrial pipe into a stagnant, murky river, surrounded by dead vegetation under a bleak, grey sky.

archetypes.name: Unappetizing Food
archetypes.core_difference: Gustatory aversion combining strange textures and a clear human facial grimace in a dining context.
archetypes.visual_elements: wrinkled nose, grimacing mouth, plate of grey lumpy meat, dimly lit dingy cafeteria
archetypes.text_query: A diner stares with a deeply wrinkled nose and grimacing mouth at a plate of grey, lumpy, unidentifiable meat served in a dimly lit, dingy cafeteria.

archetypes.name: Dirty Restroom
archetypes.core_difference: Architectural decay highlighting filth and unsanitary conditions with harsh, unflattering lighting.
archetypes.visual_elements: stained cracked sink, dark grime, mysterious puddles, flickering sickly green fluorescent bulb
archetypes.text_query: A deeply stained, cracked public restroom sink is covered in dark grime and mysterious puddles, illuminated by a flickering, sickly green fluorescent bulb overhead.

emotions.definition: Energetic enthusiasm, anticipation, thrill, or stimulation.

archetypes.name: Music Festival Crowd
archetypes.core_difference: Separates from amusement by focusing on intense collective euphoric energy, roaring, and vibrant sensory overload.
archetypes.visual_elements: cheering crowd jumping, hands raised in air, piercing neon laser lights, nighttime music festival
archetypes.text_query: A massive, cheering crowd jumps enthusiastically with hands raised in the air, bathed in piercing neon laser lights at a high-energy nighttime music festival.

archetypes.name: Surfing Action
archetypes.core_difference: Dynamic sports action emphasizing high speed, athletic skill, and adrenaline in bright nature.
archetypes.visual_elements: skilled surfer carving, steep glowing blue ocean wave, brilliant spray of white water, sunny sky
archetypes.text_query: A skilled surfer aggressively carves down the steep face of a massive, glowing blue ocean wave, sending a brilliant spray of white water into the sunny sky.

archetypes.name: Opening a Gift
archetypes.core_difference: Unrestrained, wide-eyed anticipation and purely domestic thrill, distinct from calm contentment.
archetypes.visual_elements: young child tearing bright red wrapping paper, large birthday present, mouth wide open screaming, bright living room
archetypes.text_query: A young child furiously tears the bright red wrapping paper off a large birthday present, mouth wide open in a scream of pure joy in a bright living room.

archetypes.name: Sprinter Winning
archetypes.core_difference: Triumphant, explosive athletic energy at a climactic moment, contrasting with the hostility of anger.
archetypes.visual_elements: muscular sprinter crossing finish line, bright red track, arms thrown upward, roaring in victory, bright stadium lighting
archetypes.text_query: A muscular sprinter crosses the finish line on a bright red track, throwing both arms upward and roaring in victory under clear, bright stadium lighting.

archetypes.name: Rollercoaster Drop
archetypes.core_difference: Visceral thrill and high speed captured in a mechanical amusement setting, evoking adrenaline rather than fear.
archetypes.visual_elements: riders screaming, arms thrown up, bright yellow rollercoaster car, steep steel drop, clear blue sky
archetypes.text_query: Riders throw their arms up and scream in sheer thrill as their bright yellow rollercoaster car plunges down a terrifyingly steep steel drop against a clear blue sky.

archetypes.name: Motion Blur City
archetypes.core_difference: Abstract, kinetic energy of urban nightlife conveyed purely through long-exposure photographic technique without specific subjects.
archetypes.visual_elements: long exposure photography, rushing river of red and white light trails, busy nighttime city street, fast-paced electricity
archetypes.text_query: Long exposure photography transforms a busy nighttime city street into a rushing river of vibrant red and white light trails, conveying a sense of fast-paced urban electricity.

emotions.definition: Alarm, anxiety, perceived danger, threat, or vulnerability.

archetypes.name: Shadowy Figure
archetypes.core_difference: Differentiates from awe by placing the subject in a vulnerable, oppressive darkness rather than a majestic vastness.
archetypes.visual_elements: blurred unidentifiable shadowy figure, desolate dim concrete parking garage, heavy darkness
archetypes.text_query: A blurred, unidentifiable shadowy figure stands motionless at the far end of a desolate, dimly lit concrete parking garage, surrounded by oppressive, heavy darkness.

archetypes.name: Bear Encounter
archetypes.core_difference: Immediate physical danger from an unpredictable wild animal, triggering survival alarm rather than wonder.
archetypes.visual_elements: terrified frozen hiker, narrow fog-shrouded forest trail, massive dark grizzly bear rearing on hind legs
archetypes.text_query: A terrified hiker freezes on a narrow, fog-shrouded forest trail as a massive, dark grizzly bear rears up on its hind legs just yards away.

archetypes.name: Panicked Eyes
archetypes.core_difference: Direct human facial expression of pure terror, utilizing tight framing and isolated low-key lighting.
archetypes.visual_elements: wide panicked eyes looking upward, pitch-black shadows, bead of sweat, harsh cold spotlight, tight dramatic portrait
archetypes.text_query: A tight, dramatic portrait shows a person's wide, panicked eyes looking upward from pitch-black shadows, a single bead of sweat reflecting a harsh, cold spotlight.

archetypes.name: Looming Tornado
archetypes.core_difference: Imminent environmental destruction highlighting extreme human helplessness against vast, dark forces.
archetypes.visual_elements: massive churning dark grey tornado, touching ground, isolated fragile wooden farmhouse, apocalyptic greenish-black storm sky
archetypes.text_query: A massive, churning dark grey tornado touches the ground ominously just behind a fragile, isolated wooden farmhouse under an apocalyptic, greenish-black storm sky.

archetypes.name: Dizzying Cliff POV
archetypes.core_difference: Induces visceral phobic anxiety regarding heights and falling through an unstable first-person perspective.
archetypes.visual_elements: looking straight down, crumbling edge of high canyon cliff, jagged threatening rocks far below, harsh midday shadows
archetypes.text_query: Looking straight down from the crumbling edge of a dizzyingly high canyon cliff, the jagged rocks far below appear threatening and unstable in harsh midday shadows.

archetypes.name: Abandoned Hospital
archetypes.core_difference: Creepy, unsettling atmosphere relying on architectural decay, isolation, and eerie cold color tones.
archetypes.visual_elements: decaying abandoned hospital corridor, peeling paint, overturned rusty wheelchairs, single flickering blue light, deep darkness
archetypes.text_query: A decaying, abandoned hospital corridor stretches into darkness, with peeling paint, overturned rusty wheelchairs, and a single flickering blue light creating an atmosphere of deep dread.

emotions.definition: Sorrow, unhappiness, grief, loss, loneliness, or disappointment.

archetypes.name: Rainy Bench Isolation
archetypes.core_difference: Contrasts with contentment by turning solitary weather into a symbol of urban isolation and heavy, somber mood.
archetypes.visual_elements: lone hunched figure in dark coat, isolated wet park bench, gazing downward, relentless grey rain, empty street
archetypes.text_query: A lone, hunched figure in a dark coat sits isolated on a wet park bench, gazing downward as heavy, relentless grey rain falls on the empty city street.

archetypes.name: Wilted Rose
archetypes.core_difference: Still life symbolizing decay, memory, and profound loss through inanimate objects without showing human tears.
archetypes.visual_elements: single severely wilted red rose, drooping over dusty glass vase, scattered dried petals, faded old photograph, dim moody lighting
archetypes.text_query: A single, severely wilted red rose droops over the edge of a dusty glass vase, its dried petals scattered beside a faded old photograph in dim, moody lighting.

archetypes.name: Stray Dog
archetypes.core_difference: Evokes pity and heartbreak via an abandoned, suffering animal in a desolate urban setting.
archetypes.visual_elements: scruffy emaciated stray dog, wet concrete sidewalk, head hanging low, weak yellow glow of solitary streetlamp
archetypes.text_query: A scruffy, emaciated stray dog sits on a wet concrete sidewalk, head hanging low and eyes cast downward under the weak, yellow glow of a solitary streetlamp.

archetypes.name: Broken Toy
archetypes.core_difference: Childhood disappointment and quiet sorrow captured intimately indoors, separating from the energetic joy of excitement.
archetypes.visual_elements: small weeping child, shadowed bedroom floor, tear-streaked face, holding broken pieces of wooden toy
archetypes.text_query: A small child sits on a shadowed bedroom floor, quietly weeping with a tear-streaked face while gently holding the broken pieces of a favorite wooden toy.

archetypes.name: Desolate Winter Landscape
archetypes.core_difference: Vast environmental emptiness using completely muted tones and barren subjects to project overarching melancholy.
archetypes.visual_elements: barren snow-covered field, grey overcast horizon, single leafless twisted oak tree, freezing cold
archetypes.text_query: A vast, barren snow-covered field stretches toward a grey, overcast horizon, containing only a single, completely leafless, twisted oak tree standing alone in the freezing cold.

archetypes.name: Hospital Window Grief
archetypes.core_difference: Profound grief and confinement in a clinical space, emphasizing emotional weight and separation.
archetypes.visual_elements: weary person leaning forehead, cold sterile hospital window pane, staring blankly, dull overcast cityscape, expression of grief
archetypes.text_query: A weary person leans their forehead against a cold, sterile hospital window pane, staring blankly out at a dull, overcast cityscape with an expression of profound grief.
